voice_0a4204db7d46e81c.text: Come a little closer to the phone.

voice_0b1b3fc551798485.text: Saat yönünde dönmeye devam et, sırtın telefona çapraz olsun ve dur.

voice_0ea46baf96293cdf.text: Saat yönünün tersine hafifçe geri dön.

voice_126fc5ad69cb572b.text: Kollarını omuz hizasına kaldır, yanlara düz aç.

voice_14eb5ec87b6ec3b4.text: Wear fitted clothes and keep your whole body in frame.

voice_183290e677d22292.text: You can turn back to the phone.

voice_1af96c60ac6956ab.text: Çıkar ya da dar bir şey giy.

voice_1bcd800bc827eb9b.text: Face the phone with your arms straight out, and hold still.

voice_2620bd18158d932c.text: Telefona dönük dur, kollarını vücudundan biraz uzak tut.

voice_2698bdc4fefb7b25.text: Bu ölçüler vücudundan büyük görünüyor, büyük ihtimalle kıyafetin yüzünden.

voice_2e1ce2b28728cf28.text: Now we'll measure you from eight sides.

voice_31bfdcd885796ab7.text: Stop and hold still for a moment.

voice_320ec8c369342383.text: Your clothes look loose, which makes the measurements too large.

voice_36456c179775207b.text: Saat yönünde dönmeye devam et, sağ yanın telefona baksın ve dur.

voice_36d96eea471241f0.text: Kıyafetin bol görünüyor, bu ölçüleri büyütür.

voice_3992da05024dc2aa.text: We couldn't find you in the photo.

voice_3c2c62549d4f92b4.text: Saat yönünde biraz dön, telefona çapraz dur.

voice_3c3b0b326a8ba8d9.text: Baştan ayağa tamamen görünene kadar biraz geri git.

voice_3e67be3972a6d007.text: Dar kıyafet giy ve tüm vücudunu kadrajda tut.

voice_3e73b8452d5164c8.text: Hold your arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, in one straight line, and keep them there.

voice_44cb4066d6e11102.text: Doğru beden için dar kıyafetle ya da iç çamaşırıyla tekrar tara.

voice_48ba1aaaaaee0656.text: Kollarını omuz hizasında yanlara tam aç, iki kolun düz bir çizgi olsun ve hep böyle tut.

voice_505dc8d427bb2e1f.text: Move to the centre of the frame.

voice_529256703aa91577.text: Keep turning clockwise a little more, back diagonal again, and stop.

voice_5dcf8718216f8256.text: These measurements look larger than your body, probably because of your clothes.

voice_644da2d24cd63a1a.text: Stand facing the phone, arms slightly away from your body.

voice_6e97c1cf22bcfbed.text: Keep turning clockwise until your right side faces the phone, and stop.

voice_739f2de7d52e2fd7.text: Move to the middle of the picture.

voice_75f64f1548566de9.text: Kolların yanlara açık, telefona dönük dur ve kıpırdama.

voice_8074a9fd4dbbe5ff.text: Step back or tilt the phone.

voice_8d4c7ce3782c2f30.text: Saat yönünde biraz daha dön, sırtın yine çapraz olsun ve dur.

voice_91b1c161e5cda4c2.text: For the right sizes, scan again in fitted clothes or underwear.

voice_9999a67740f8bedb.heard: Your measurements are ready to see.

voice_99ca706c9ac96f1a.text: Step back until you're fully visible, head to feet.

voice_a476508588685e19.text: Saat yönünde dönmeye devam et, sol yanın telefona baksın ve dur.

voice_a7df4ff5a5ecc63b.text: saat yönünde biraz daha dön, önün telefona çapraz olsun ve dur.

voice_aa52aacb8b1919a2.text: Make sure your whole body is visible and the room is well lit.

voice_ad0c7f65dea05a18.text: Hold your arms slightly away from your body.

voice_b5f3cc5b3461e5eb.text: Keep turning clockwise until your back faces the phone, and stop.

voice_b6aefbd43229abc4.text: Hep saat yönünde, yani sağına doğru döneceksin ve ben söyleyince duracaksın.

voice_b8f8d4a2bd2b891e.text: Take them off or put on something fitted.

voice_bd7e85e1b881f079.text: Tüm vücudunun göründüğünden ve ortamın aydınlık olduğundan emin ol.

voice_c0311c6f5696677e.text: Turn a little clockwise, so you stand diagonally to the phone, and stop.

voice_c2f26d52e7927178.text: turn clockwise a little more, front diagonal to the phone, and stop.

voice_d3c55799e06d4ac8.text: Raise your arms to shoulder height, straight out to the sides.

voice_e57575b74447f227.text: You'll always turn clockwise, to your right, and stop when I tell you.

voice_e6135272e2430db2.text: Saat yönünde dönmeye devam et, sırtın telefona baksın ve dur.

voice_efe80d82671f3af0.text: Keep turning clockwise until your left side faces the phone, and stop.

voice_f1f31f434749cde1.text: Keep turning clockwise until your back is diagonal to the phone, and stop.
